messages:
maria: Quick heads-up 1h until the window (01:00 PDT). Goal: pin prod -> `redwood/v3.3.1-rc1` and run a short canary. Freeze window T-15m to T+15m. Call ownership and quick blockers now.

eli: Acknowledged. I'll drive the rollout. Canary slice=canary-crypto (6 pods), dwell 10m. If canary OK -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% ramp.

sre: Monitoring thresholds: p95 baseline=185ms. Rollback if error-rate >= 1% for 3m or p95 >= 400ms for 3m. Also flag memory OOMs during first 5m after promote.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pin request queued for `redwood/v3.3.1-rc1`. Canary scheduled in T+8m to canary-crypto. Canary duration: 10m.

maria: Release notes: short user blurb ready, ops blurb for incident runbook updated. Claire will add details after rollout.

sam: Oncall will watch dashboards. I'll tolerate a single 1m p95 spike to 500ms during cache warmup but not sustained. Pager set.

eli: Starting canary now. Running smoke:health and smoke:embeddings. Smoke job id `smoke-3605-01`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started on canary-crypto (6 pods).

sre: Smoke reports green. Observed p95 spike to 430ms at minute 1 then settled to 200ms. No error increase. Holding for full 10m.

maria: Thanks. If steady for 10m we promote to 20%. Rollback commands for record: `/deploy rollback --to=redwood/v3.3.0` and `deploy-bot abort --slice=canary-crypto`.

sam: All good from monitoring side. Green to promote. I'll keep watch for 30m post-full-promote.

ops: Freeze noted. Non-critical merges blocked until T+15m. Will update the calendar.

eli: Canary complete, no sustained breaches. Promoting to 20% now. Will post final promote/rollback confirmations after full ramp.
